title: Utility Street Cuts - Hazardous
description: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report concerns about cuts made in street, alley or sidewalk that are hazardous. A utility cut is when a contractor has cut an opening into the street and covers the hole up with a steel plate because work is not finished. ** Utility Cuts are generally - SQUARE, if other please complete a Street Repair - Routine SR. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day.
instructions: This request must be dispatched. Please call 311 to report concerns about cuts made in street, alley or sidewalk that are hazardous. A utility cut is when a contractor has cut an opening into the street and covers the hole up with a steel plate because work is not finished. Utility Cuts are generally square; if other, please complete a Street Repair - Routine service request. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 1 calendar day. Please call 311 for more information

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone to report a hazardous utility cut.
actions.why: For a hazardous contractor cut in a street, alley, or sidewalk, where an unfinished opening is covered with a steel plate. The description and instructions for "Utility Street Cuts - Hazardous" requests on the Dallas 311 website say this request must be dispatched and direct people to call 311. They direct cuts that are not generally square to Street Repair - Routine; the saved "Street Repair" 311 request form also directs hazardous cases to call 311 by phone.
actions.how: Call 311; for a hazardous cut that is not generally square, ask about Street Repair
actions.how_formatted: Call [311](tel:311); for a hazardous cut that is not generally square, ask about Street Repair
